visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoors, a young woman with long brown hair helps a toddler boy wearing a white button-down shirt and a blue bow tie look into a wooden-framed mirror. (2) Inside a car, the boy sits in a grey car seat, touching his cheek and waving with small hands. (3) In a restaurant with warm lighting and wooden decor, the woman presents a gift bag to the boy in a high chair. He takes out a glowing green Teletubby-shaped lamp. (4) Multiple women surround the boy, showing him yellow rain boots, sneakers, and clothing. He holds the glowing lamp, his eyes wide with curiosity. (5) A woman in a black shirt holds the boy as he points at the glowing lamp. In the background, other women sit at a long wooden table, smiling and watching. (6) A woman dresses the boy in grey pants while he remains seated. (7) The boy stands and mimics a roaring motion with his hands while someone pets his head. (8) A large green grape cake with a lit candle is placed on the table. The boy claps his hands while looking at the cake. (9) A woman feeds the boy a slice of cake with a fork. He opens his mouth wide and eats. (10) Back in the car seat, the boy looks at the camera, waving his hand slightly.
